claims.text: Michael Powers is identified on the Department of War Comptroller site as Acting Under Secretary of War (Comptroller)/Chief Financial Officer, a CPA, Certified Defense Financial Manager and DoD Financial Management Certification Level 3 holder.

b.label: The Classified Annex (NDAA and Defense Appropriations)

edges.label: The Comptroller executes the annex
edges.note: The Under Secretary (Comptroller)/CFO is the official responsible for execution of appropriated funds including those directed by the classified annex tables under section 8006(a). Reasoned inference from the office's statutory functions; no document names the incumbent in connection with the annex.
